**What to add or change**
A clear description of the lesson / term / case / standard, or the correction.

**Why it matters for learners**
How this helps someone learning agentic IAM.

**Source(s)**
Primary docs, specs, or research backing the claim (links). Required for factual content.

**Where it fits**
Which page/section (e.g. Foundations lesson, glossary, case files, standards radar).
